           BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

      SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all of the B3-1 Community Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on
Map 13-L in the area bounded by:

        West Higgins Avenue, a line 103.25 feet southeast of and parallel to North Long Avenue, the 18 foot
        public alley south of West Higgins Avenue, and a line 81.50 feet southeast of and parallel to North
        Long Avenue.

to those of a B3-3 Community Shopping District.

       SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.
